2.why: Transit.cpp:665 divides its voltage by 10 and adds it to the fade time

comment: The manual calls the fade-clamp option Disable CV clamping; the installed v2.5.0 source has it as Clamp Fade CV input, with the sense reversed. The item name here follows the source. What the CV input expects depends on the Slot CV mode: a trigger in the sequencing modes and in ARM, a 0 to 10V ramp across the presets in VOLT and in PHASE, and 1V per twelve presets in C4. In C4 mode a second channel on the same cable triggers the load, so there the jack reads two channels of a polyphonic cable. PHASE is the one mode that reads the voltage continuously rather than as a step.
